description: Two coin tossers: a trigger in sends a trigger or a gate to one of two outputs, with the odds set by a knob and by a control voltage, and every channel of a polyphonic cable tossed separately

params.text: Sets the odds for that section: fully counter-clockwise every trigger goes to A, fully clockwise every trigger goes to B, centred it is an even toss
Switches that section between direct, where each toss picks the A or the B output, and toggle, where a tails result moves the signal to the other output and heads leaves it
Switches that section between passing the incoming gate through to the chosen output and latching, where the chosen output stays high until a later toss picks the other one

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V tosses the coin for the top section, and the number of channels on the cable sets how many independent coins that section tosses
A rising edge past 2V tosses the coin for the bottom section; with nothing patched here the top section's input is read instead, so one trigger tosses both coins and each gives its own result
Adds to that section's probability knob, 10V covering the whole knob range

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that section's toss stands at A; with the section passing gates through it follows the length of the incoming gate, and with the section latching it stays high until a toss picks B
Carries 10V while that section's toss stands at B; with the section passing gates through it follows the length of the incoming gate, and with the section latching it stays high until a toss picks A

notes: the module is polyphonic: the channel count of a section's input cable sets how many coins that section tosses, and its two outputs carry that many channels.
menu: LEDs channel — picks which polyphonic channel the lamp between a section's outputs reports; the choice applies to both sections

inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the input of section 1.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.

0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
